title.narrative: Strengthening the Timbira Fund for autonomous territorial and environmental management

description.narrative: The objective of the support is for the Timbira indigenous communities to have reached a new level of social well-being and territorial management through the strengthening of the Timbira Fund. Outcomes include 1) Establishment of the Timbira Fund completed, 2) Timbira community projects supported and monitored, and 3) Wyty Catë Association strengthened as an implementing agency. The project reaches 4 indigenous lands (Apinayé, Kraolândia, Krikati and Governador) in the states of Maranhão and Tocantins, spanning 632.000 hectares and a little over 9.000 indigenous persons. The fund will have a specific thematic line to support women’s projects within the portfolio of micro and small community projects, in recognition of the role they play in territorial and environmental management and cultural strengthening.
